lines.en: I walk on empty air.
The ground cracks in fine lines beneath me.

lines.zh: 气从我的肩后拖成光带。
lines.en: Ki trails in a band behind my shoulder.
I close in at a slow pace, unhurried.
The wind parts for me and closes again.
I hover and look down.
This land is too small for me.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在你们头上。
lines.en: My shadow falls over your heads.
Each step makes the air sink.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，是给你时间怕。
lines.en: I walk slowly to give you time to fear.
The wrecked docks lie beneath me.
Dust scatters when I land.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂，俯视这片地。
lines.en: I fold my arms and survey the land.
Ki gathers in a small ball in my palm.

lines.zh: 我让气在掌里转成一个圆。
lines.en: Ki turns into a sphere in my palm.
This gravity can't hold me down.
I listen to the wind far off.
My hair drifts in my own aura.

lines.zh: 我打量着这个世界的天。
lines.en: I study this world's sky.

lines.zh: 手臂上的肌肉绷了一下。
lines.en: The muscles in my arm flex once.
I am measuring your power levels.
Quiet, I'm in no hurry to strike.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，地起了尘。
lines.en: I exhale and dust rises.

lines.zh: 我活动手腕，骨节一路响。
lines.en: I roll my wrists and my joints crack down the line.
This sky tastes unfamiliar.
I wait to see who moves first.
You, look up.
This little ki, and you call yourself a fighter?
Stand straight; I haven't even looked hard yet.
I'll remember that face.
You'd challenge me? Interesting.
Don't look down, I'm watching.
You should grip tighter.

lines.zh: 在我面前站着，需要勇气。
lines.en: Standing before me takes nerve.

lines.zh: 你以为这身盔甲挡得住？
lines.en: Think that armor would stop me?
I didn't come to hear you talk.
You're breathing too fast.

lines.zh: 把力气用在该用的地方。
lines.en: Spend your strength where it counts.

lines.zh: 我看得出你没打过真架。
lines.en: I can tell you've never fought for real.
Stand straight, don't disappoint me.

lines.zh: 我这一身绿皮，力量全开。
lines.en: Green skin, and every ounce of power out.
There's no fighting spirit in you.
I'm good at reading that look.
Don't blink, I'll move.
That one had some bite.
You actually touched me.

lines.zh: 全力状态被打退半步，有意思。
lines.en: Knocked back half a step at full power — interesting.
Blood slides from my lip.
My ki faltered for an instant.
That pain doesn't concern me.
I'll make you repay it twice over.
My arm has gone numb.
Not bad, you have some talent.

lines.zh: 全力一开，气浪先压过来。
lines.en: Full power out, and the ki comes first.
Is that worth bending down for?
Set it down, then step far back.

lines.zh: 你以为用吃的就能收买我？
lines.en: You think food buys me?
In space I never went hungry.
Hand it over, let me see.
So little sweetness, how pitiful.
You'd trade that for your life?
My appetite is larger than you think.
Don't shake, it'll soil the ground.
I'd swallow such things whole.
You walked into a wall.
Don't test my patience with your body.

lines.zh: 气在我肩后拖成一条光带。
lines.en: Ki trails behind my shoulders in a band of light.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你肩膀脱臼了吗？
lines.en: Did that pop your shoulder out?

lines.zh: 我站着没动，你倒是晃了。
lines.en: I didn't move, you're the one swaying.

lines.zh: 气在我的皮肤上弹开你。
lines.en: My aura bounced you off my skin.
You're blocking the view.
Crowd me again and you'll fly.

lines.zh: 这点重量，连尘都算不上。
lines.en: That weight isn't even dust to me.
You should learn to go around.
A boring thought.
I have no interest in the weak.
In space I seek only rivals.

lines.zh: 你连我的一拳都接不住。
lines.en: You can't take one of my punches.
Don't mistake fear for something else.
My comrades are made in battle.
Ask someone else that question.
Survive leaving here, then we'll talk.
I have no patience for that.
I prefer the aura of the strong.
What falls belongs to the victor.
I pinch up the remains.
This can't survive my grip.
I pick it up, idly.
Whoever clears the dead gets this.
This smells of that other world.
I toss it up and catch it.

lines.zh: 弱者的遗物，也算战利品。
lines.en: A weakling's relic counts as spoils.

lines.zh: 我懒得弯腰，可它闪了一下。
lines.en: I hate bending down, but it glinted.
Keep it, we'll count its worth later.
You'll do, don't move.
I've locked onto your ki.
Let's see how many hits you last.

lines.zh: 这片地，从现在开始是我的战场。
lines.en: This ground is my battlefield now.
Don't run, that's even duller.

lines.zh: 你刚做了个错误的决定。
lines.en: You just made a wrong decision.
When I strike, be ready.
I've looked forward to this fight.
Your level is only a warm-up.
Stand there and look up at me.
I choose you as the first.

lines.zh: 别再动，你的气我圈住了。
lines.en: Don't move; your ki is inside my circle.

lines.zh: 我的气会把这片天压下来。
lines.en: My ki will press this sky down.
Laugh now, while you still can.
Come, don't keep me waiting.
You're inside my circle now.
Ki is gathering, do you hear it?
Your footwork is too straight.
I predict you'll go left.
That distance is one breath away.
I'm not even at full power.

lines.zh: 你在找我的破绽，找不到。
lines.en: You're hunting a gap, there isn't one.
Your breathing grows hurried.

lines.zh: 残影还站着，我已在背后。
lines.en: My afterimage still stands; I'm behind you.
My afterimage still stands there.
Here I come, watch your feet.
This ground won't hold much longer.
Your speed still falls short.
The air is my territory.
Don't stop, stopping ends it.
I count three, then strike.

lines.zh: 你的眼里开始有恐惧了。
lines.en: Fear is creeping into your eyes.
This blow will reshape the terrain.
I've been waiting for this moment.
Take this punch squarely.
My knee drives into your gut.
The combo begins, don't bother counting.

lines.zh: 我的手肘扫过你的下巴，气还在涨。
lines.en: My elbow swept your jaw; my ki still rises.
You fly and shatter stone.
This kick will lay you out a while.
Ki-wrapped fist slams down.
You blocked the wrong side.
In the air you have no footing.
Again, I want more exercise.
This breaks your stance.
Your armor has dented.
I struck lightly, be glad.
The shockwave is still behind you.
Stand up, we're not done.
That was only three tenths of my power.
The sky tears open, I descend.
Ki presses down first, then I do.
Your world, here I come.
I drop from beyond the sky onto this land.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下发出哀鸣。
lines.en: The ground groans beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬头，这里的太阳太弱。
lines.en: I look up, this sun is weak.
The docks' planks begin to shake.
I have arrived, none can stop me.
This realm answers to me.

lines.zh: 先给你们一个机会逃走。
lines.en: I'll give you one chance to flee.

lines.zh: 我的笑声传遍了这片地。
lines.en: My laughter carries across the land.
The dust settles, I stand at the center.

lines.zh: 我数着这片天上的星星。
lines.en: I count the stars in this sky.
Don't panic, I only came to warm up.
Full power, nothing to hide.
The ki in this world is too thin.

lines.zh: 船坞的木板先震，我才落下。
lines.en: The dock planks tremble before I touch down.

lines.zh: 开始吧，让我看看你们的全力。
lines.en: Begin, show me your full strength.
Fire would burn me? Laughable.
Even I feel a fall from this height.
Water in my lungs, I'm not used to it.
The blast shoves me back a few paces.

lines.zh: 这种小东西也能扎进来。
lines.en: Even a trinket like that can pierce me.

lines.zh: 这股力量，不属于这个世界。
lines.en: This power doesn't belong to this world.
Fighting hungry dulls my strength.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，气被打散了。
lines.en: Lightning scatters my ki.
In the void there's no ki to draw.
